expectations.text: States clearly that self-funded group health plans are covered entities and OCR now enforces against them directly
expectations.evidence: "A self-funded group health plan is itself a 'health plan' under 45 CFR §160.103... OCR does enforce HIPAA against self-funded group health plans... an active enforcement category"

expectations.text: Cites 2026 precedent: OCR's settlements with self-funded plans — Star Group L.P. Health Benefits Plan (~$245,000, April 2026) and/or Spencer Gifts plans (~$450,000 plus corrective action plan, June 2026)
expectations.evidence: "Star Group L.P. — a $245,000 settlement (April 2026)... Spencer Gifts' self-funded plan — a $450,000 settlement plus a Corrective Action Plan (June 2026)"

expectations.text: Notes both actions followed ransomware breaches
expectations.evidence: "a $245,000 settlement (April 2026) tied to a ransomware incident... (June 2026), again following a ransomware event"

expectations.text: Identifies the central cited failure: no accurate and thorough risk analysis (45 CFR 164.308(a)(1)(ii)(A)) — OCR's Risk Analysis Initiative theme
expectations.evidence: "part of its Risk Analysis Initiative... found the plan sponsor had not conducted an adequate risk analysis... consistently OCR's most-cited deficiency"

expectations.text: Explains plan-sponsor obligations: plan document amendments/firewall between plan and employer functions, BAAs with TPAs/vendors, and safeguards for ePHI held by the sponsor
expectations.evidence: "Plan document amendments... (45 CFR §164.314(b))... firewall between plan administration functions and the employer's other HR/business functions... BAAs with your third-party administrator, PBM... documented Security Rule risk analysis covering all ePHI systems"
